result.title: CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution
result.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to the IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2027) and is currently under review
result.summary: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 CSC-Mamba，将多模态卷积稀疏编码的深度展开与 Vision Mamba 状态空间骨干结合，用于多对比度 MRI 超分辨率重建，并在 IXI 数据上报告 PSNR 提升。
